must: Reuse vx colour tokens with dark and light themes
Keep new project screens behind the browser preview flag
Use the authenticated gateway for tenant operations
avoid: New UI dependencies for existing primitives

decisions.decision: Use a 280px maximum width, 164–200px fixed-height bottom question dock with 11–12px text, single-line composer and collapsed examples. Reserve separate mascot and page clearance; retain the mobile guide above chat.
decisions.source: User screenshot showed an oversized desktop chat with Vey overlapping the input. User requested smaller text and a smaller chat in empty bottom space.

decisions.decision: On mobile retain the current walkthrough above the compact question panel, with a separate right-side mascot lane and Back to walkthrough control. Preserve task state and measured page clearance while chatting.
decisions.source: User requested the Max Rep walkthrough remain visible while asking questions, with Vey docked and no Credits spent.

decisions.decision: Below 640px keep Vey in a reserved lane beside the walkthrough, or above the left of chat. Scrolling never chooses a new body position. Only an explicit Show action makes a brief fixed-destination pointing gesture before returning to dock. Desktop manual placement remains available.
decisions.source: User requested a calm mobile dock because avoidance-based repositioning jumped around during scrolling.

decisions.decision: The mobile question panel uses 34dvh, bounded to 220–280px so the fixed composer fits on short screens; conversation scrolls internally. The Resume walkthrough action sits above, not over, the composer. Keep desktop chat sizing unchanged.
decisions.source: User request: the question guide takes up the whole screen and needs to be much smaller.

decisions.decision: Drag the existing touch-sized Vey launcher to position the mascot. Taps still toggle help; keyboard Alt+arrows move and Escape resets. Manual placement lasts until reset or reload, with precise pointing retained. No floating text badges or tooltips around the mascot; retain screen-reader labels and the separate walkthrough card.
decisions.source: User request to position Vey around the screen during the mobile Max Rep walkthrough.

decisions.decision: Below 640px, Vey uses a compact step card with two-line guidance and primary actions. More reveals secondary controls and full guidance; desktop remains expanded. Keep highlighted controls above the panel and preserve touch-sized actions.
decisions.source: User request: make the mobile guidance panel smaller so it does not cover controls or the image.

decisions.decision: Oddling Studio starts with a token-based dress-up doll for fast body, hair and outfit selection, followed by the full detailed trait controls. Its sticky aqua action shows the live catalog cost prominently, reserves amber for credit information, and warns signed-in users when their balance is low without charging before Create confirmation.
decisions.source: User selected a visual doll-mockup workflow and a large bright generation action with visible cost and low-credit prompting.
